name: Earthquakes & tsunami
summary: M6.8 off Timor-Leste on 21 Nov and M6.4 near Réunion on 24 Nov rated PAGER green; no M7+ in the past week
state: USGS recorded an M6.8 earthquake 105km north-east of Lospalos, Timor-Leste, and an M6.7 near Carhuamayo, Peru, on 21 Nov, an M6.5 in the Vanuatu region on 23 Nov and an M6.4 in the Mauritius–Réunion region on 24 Nov, all rated PAGER green. An M5.9 south-west of Yanglong, China, on 21 Nov was rated PAGER yellow (USGS). With no M7+ or PAGER orange alert in seven days, Normal holds.
for_you: No damaging earthquake or tsunami is under way. Anyone in a quake-prone area can follow local civil-protection guidance.
rubric_hit: Normal: no M7+ in 7 days (max M6.8); worst PAGER yellow

sources.title: USGS — M6.8, 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor Leste

why: Large earthquakes can kill thousands in seconds and disrupt global supply chains (chips, cars).
drivers: Tectonics — unpredictable; impact depends on depth, location and building standards.

rubric.alert: PAGER red, or a tsunami causing damage.
rubric.watch: M7+ in the past 7 days, or PAGER orange, or a tsunami warning issued.
rubric.normal: No USGS PAGER orange/red alert and no M7+ in the past 7 days.
